title: If this is slop, call me a slop lover
author: Interesting-Rent5630
selftext:
This game has been in the back of my head for over 20 years.  Finally with Opus, Astra, and Sol it has come to life.  I've spent a ridiculous amount of time combining all the best aspects of chaos, randomness, humor, gore, dismemberment, bad puns, and unique mechanics together to create a multiplayer game that is focused on replayability.  NO TWO GAMES ARE THE SAME. EVER.

Randomly slot machines drop in the match and pulling the lever triggers multiple chaos modes that stack with each other.  I named the game **SLOTS OF CHAOS: MELEE ARENA** because I just had to.

I have learned so much during the process and am really happy with the result.  There are still many things I'm planning to add, so stay tuned. Since I used Claude and Codex, I know it will automatically be called slop by some... but you know what?  I don't care.  I'm proud of this slop. If this type of game is your jam, I bet you will honestly have fun regardless of how you feel about AI. I think we are on the cusp of seeing a lot of really good games coming from passionate people with modern tools. I'm genuinely excited for whatever is going to come next after this.  Also, maybe I'm misreading, but it feels like the tone has finally started to shift a bit the last few weeks.  I'm glad to see less AI hate and more voices speaking up about its utility.

Store page: [https://store.steampowered.com/app/5506620/Slots\_of\_Chaos\_Melee\_Arena/](https://store.steampowered.com/app/5506620/Slots_of_Chaos_Melee_Arena/)
